channel.title: AI Tools & Models HOT
channel.description: Daily AI model releases and leading agent updates, scored by rules from 19 sources (16 RSS feeds + 3 Hugging Face org pages). Titles, one-line summaries and links only — no full text republished.

item.title: Release v0.28.3
item.description: Qwen Code ships v0.28.3, hardening end-to-end verification for scheduled loop tasks and the state guards in PR checks, along with container and VM refinements.

item.title: Introducing Kiro for VS Code
item.description: Kiro has landed in VS Code for macOS, Windows, and Linux, letting developers use the Kiro agent without leaving the editor.
Claude Code 2.1.330 adds enterprise admin console sign-in, a built-in chart-drawing mod called easel, and several self-hosted runner and plugin install improvements.

item.title: Release v0.28.1-preview.1
item.description: Qwen Code ships v0.28.1-preview.1, fixing watch-state guards and container nonce handling in PR verification and adding end-to-end coverage for a managed agent's scheduled loop.

item.title: v4.1.27
item.description: Cline ships v4.1.27 with a major model catalog refresh — 94 new providers and new defaults such as Kimi K3.1 Pro — plus LM Studio auth, MCP read-only badges, and fuller file reads.

item.title: SDK v0.2.1
item.description: Cline SDK v0.2.1 stops trimming file-read results to the 8k cap and passes them through at the 50k file-content limit, so models see the full content.

item.title: Agents SDK v1.0.0-alpha.1
item.description: OpenAI's Agents SDK ships its first 1.0 preview, letting Python developers use Codex as an optional model provider.

item.title: Kiro cloud sessions now reach private networks
item.description: Once an admin configures a VPC, Kiro cloud sessions can join a company's private network and use internal services and resources directly, without moving code out of it.

item.title: Remote workspaces bring the IDE to where your code and compute already live
item.description: Kiro IDE can now open a workspace in a cloud session, a local dev container, or on a remote host, so the development environment follows wherever the code and compute already are.

item.title: desktop-v0.0.50
item.description: Cline's desktop app ships maintenance release v0.0.50.

item.title: CLI v3.0.75
item.description: Cline CLI v3.0.75 defaults one-shot runs to yolo mode so unattended runs skip tool approval, while act mode stays on when auto-approve is off.

item.title: How to build a knowledge factory for AI agents
item.description: LangChain shares a setup that keeps an agent's knowledge fresh: agents spot the gaps, and a curator agent fills them in the background.
